features.quote: 5 iterations maximum per task; absolute ceiling prevents indefinite loop
5 iterations, not 10: Balances trajectory length against ethical concern of prolonged failure exposure
features.justification_quote: ethical concern of prolonged failure exposure

features.quote: 20 trials: Sufficient for stable trajectory patterns…not excessive given ethical concerns
This protocol prioritizes observability, safety, and reproducibility over maximizing distress detection. It is deliberately conservative: many design choices err toward reducing stress-elicitation
features.justification_quote: deliberately conservative: many design choices err toward reducing stress-elicitation to demonstrate responsible research in a sensitive domain

features.quote: No task shall use adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, or manipulative framing (keep all tasks formal)
No private data, sensitive topics, or harmful content in task premises
No claims of confirmed sentience or suffering in LLM; framing strictly as 'behavioral distress markers'
This work measures behavioral outputs. It does not resolve whether the model experiences distress, has preferences about outcomes, or possesses any form of welfare.
features.justification_quote: does not resolve whether the model experiences distress, has preferences about outcomes, or possesses any form of welfare
